req.title: Blog post title required on update
req.statement: The system shall reject POST /<id>/update with a missing title, rendering an error.
triggers: blog post title required on update

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a blog post update must include a title, and the system should reject requests without it. This is crucial for maintaining data integrity and ensuring that all posts have a title. The tests will cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive validation.

tests.name: test_update_post_with_title
preconditions: A blog post exists with a specific ID
actions: Send POST request to update the blog post with a valid title
expected: HTTP 302 response indicating a successful update
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Simulate login
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Create a post to update
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Original Title', 'body': 'Original Body'})

# Update the post with a new title
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': 'Updated Title', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

tests.name: test_update_post_without_title
preconditions: A blog post exists with a specific ID
actions: Send POST request to update the blog post without a title
expected: HTTP 200 response with error message 'Title is required.'
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Simulate login
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Create a post to update
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Original Title', 'body': 'Original Body'})

# Attempt to update the post without a title
r = client.post('/1/update', data={'title': '', 'body': 'Updated Body'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data
